AnswerCheck.description:
The validator's verdict on one answer attempt: accepted, or sent back with readable
reasons (the model then rewrites it). `repairs` counts fact-free fixes applied first.
AnswerCheck.title: AnswerCheck

AnswerDraft.description:
Provisional summary text while the model writes its answer. Not checked yet: the client
shows it as a draft and replaces it with the validated `text.delta` stream.
AnswerDraft.title: AnswerDraft

AssistantScope.description:
What the resident assistant covers (T-011): `access_flood` (the default) or `all`. The
resident screen shows features outside access and flood, such as Rehearse my trip, only
under `all`, so the screen and the assistant agree on what residents can ask about.
AssistantScope.title: AssistantScope

AssumeFact.description: Imagine one recorded fact on a path, e.g. width_m = 1.2.
AssumeFact.title: AssumeFact

Banner.description: The set-piece banners: Hari Raya hold, monsoon stretch, handover.
Banner.title: Banner

BuildRamp.description: Imagine a capital work: the path rebuilt step-free (steps become a ramp).
BuildRamp.title: BuildRamp

BuildingsLayer.description: OSM building footprints and trees for the stylised 3D city (display only).
BuildingsLayer.title: BuildingsLayer

ChatEventDoc.description: Wrapper used only so that OpenAPI exports the ChatEvent union for the TS client.
ChatEventDoc.title: ChatEventDoc

ClosePath.description: Imagine a path closed (works, an event, a fallen tree).
ClosePath.title: ClosePath

disclaimer.default: Detour pressure, estimated from mapped road class and sample trips, not traffic counts.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

ClosureOut.description: A closure as the public sees it: always a staff report, never a verified fact.
ClosureOut.title: ClosureOut

CompareEnd.description: A route end of a compare: the place id and its name.
CompareEnd.title: CompareEnd

CompareRoute.description:
One route of a compare, trimmed for the scene: geometry as [lon, lat] points in travel
order and the edge sequence with its evaluation.
CompareRoute.title: CompareRoute

disclaimer.default: Proposed course on mapped roads, not an approved route.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

DailyLifeMatrix.description: Walks from the tower entrance to the four daily-life targets, per profile.
DailyLifeMatrix.title: DailyLifeMatrix

DayTrip.description:
One resident's own trip through a rehearsed day (Cycle 19). Times are clock text; every
outcome comes from the engine. A rehearsal, not a forecast.
DayTrip.title: DayTrip

DayTripRequest.description:
Ends are place ids, or points tapped on the map ("lon,lat"). Points travel in the body,
never in the URL, so a resident's home never lands in an access log (PDPA).
DayTripRequest.title: DayTripRequest

DevelopmentPlan.description: Everything the Development Simulation player needs (spec 2026-10-21 §6).
DevelopmentPlan.title: DevelopmentPlan

DevsimDetour.description: A resident's walk to the mall before and after the hoarding closes the frontage edge.
DevsimDetour.title: DevsimDetour

DevsimEvacuation.description: The nearest reachable evacuation centre from the tower entrance (default walk).
DevsimEvacuation.title: DevsimEvacuation

hypothetical.default: Hypothetical tower · not an SDP project · 30 storeys · ~500 homes
hypothetical.title: Hypothetical

DevsimPlayground.description:
The playground nearest the tower entrance on foot (routing engine, default profile): where
the move-in children play (spec §6.2, AC-W5). Decorative figures stand there; no copy quotes
it today.
DevsimPlayground.title: DevsimPlayground

EvacuationReport.description: Journeys from a seeded sample of origins to the nearest reachable evacuation centre.
EvacuationReport.title: EvacuationReport

disclaimer.default: Estimate from mapped roads and sample trips, not traffic counts.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

note.default: Sampled journeys on the township model; a planning estimate, not a promise. Residents never see these numbers.
note.title: Note

FloodExposure.description:
At handover: the river-rise scenario from which the entrance's usual walk to the main road
crosses a likely-flooded stretch. Indicative scenario, not a forecast; no depths.
FloodExposure.title: FloodExposure

GapProperties.description: Per element: how many facts are not yet checked for the profile, and why it matters.
GapProperties.title: GapProperties

HoardingHome.description: One residential building within the radius, before vs after the hoarding (default walk).
HoardingHome.title: HoardingHome

HoardingImpact.description:
Every nearby home's walks to the four targets before and after the hoarding closes the
frontage paths (routing engine; default profile for minutes, wheelchair for links cut).

provenance.default: routing engine, default profile (wheelchair profile for links cut)
provenance.title: Provenance

HoardingImpact.title: HoardingImpact

HoardingOption.description: The impact with only one side of the site hoarded (its frontage walk paths closed).
HoardingOption.title: HoardingOption

ImpactBrief.description:
The Impact Brief panel (from 33 s). Replaces the 66 s end card: every value is a computed
fact (ROUTE, FLOOD) or a labelled ESTIMATE / CALENDAR figure; check_plan reads every digit.
ImpactBrief.title: ImpactBrief

ImpactTarget.description:
A daily-life destination: Lakeside Mall, Urban Park, and the school and clinic nearest the
tower entrance on foot (default profile). Every home uses the same four.
ImpactTarget.title: ImpactTarget

JourneyEvent.description: One stop of a journey (spec §6.1), derived by journey.build_journey from world data only.
JourneyEvent.title: JourneyEvent

JourneyPlan.description: A planned route turned into a deterministic trip the 3D player animates (spec §6.1).
JourneyPlan.title: JourneyPlan

LorryRoute.description: Construction lorries: `drive` route from the nearest major road to the site gate.

school_run_note.default: School run assumed 7–8 am (typical); not from data
school_run_note.title: School Run Note

LorryRoute.title: LorryRoute

LorrySensitive.description: A school, kindergarten, park or playground within 50 m of the lorry route.
LorrySensitive.title: LorrySensitive

disclaimer.default: Detour pressure, estimated from mapped road class and sample trips, not traffic counts.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

MonsoonSetPiece.description:
The northeast-monsoon stretch the playback stages (ruling R25): the first band that starts
after the Hari Raya set piece and before handover, else the band containing Hari Raya.
`days_lost` per month counts structure work only, so it is 0 in a fit-out month.
MonsoonSetPiece.title: MonsoonSetPiece

NoJourney.description: Why there is no journey to play: the route status and a plain message.
NoJourney.title: NoJourney

ProfileInfo.description: Read-only profile parameters, for the 'Assumptions' section. No secrets, no per-user data.
ProfileInfo.title: ProfileInfo

RaisePaths.description:
Imagine a capital work against floods: these path segments rebuilt above the township's
indicative flood levels (they no longer flood in any scenario). Imagined only: the real flood
data is never changed, and nothing says the real path is above any water level.
RaisePaths.title: RaisePaths

RayaSetPiece.description:
The one Hari Raya Aidilfitri site shutdown the playback stages (the first during structure
work). `days` is the assumed shutdown length in working days, beyond the gazetted holidays.
RayaSetPiece.title: RayaSetPiece

ReasonSet.description:
Per-route reasons from known facts only (spec D2): a field is None when no edge on the
route has a known value for it. Unknown values never count for or against a route.
`steps` is stricter (R44): None ("not checked yet") unless every edge's step count is known,
so 0 means every edge is known to have no steps, never a partly known route.
ReasonSet.title: ReasonSet

ResidentFacts.description: The only facts a resident's lines may quote (routing engine, their own profile).
ResidentFacts.title: ResidentFacts

disclaimer.default: Synthetic residents on the township model: an indicative simulation, not a forecast. River stages are scenarios, not water depths; departure times, warnings and crowding are not modelled; animation speed is illustrative. Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

RouteCompare.description:
The `route.compare` payload: compare_routes' result as recorded this turn (run.py builds
it from TurnRecord.compares; the model never writes any of it). `fastest` is the shortest
walk, `recommended` the profile's route; with `same_path` both are the same route.
RouteCompare.title: RouteCompare

SceneIntent.description: A scene intent on the wire (SSE `scene.intent`).
SceneIntent.title: SceneIntent

Schedule.description:
ESTIMATE: an indicative schedule and cost for the Hypothetical Development, from the
published benchmarks and labelled assumptions in the sources doc
(docs/04-architecture/devsim-estimates-sources.md, `devsim_schedule.SOURCES`). Not an SDP
figure, a quotation or a forecast.
Schedule.title: Schedule

SetRiverStage.description: River rise scenario (indicative stages only; a stage never upgrades anything).
SetRiverStage.title: SetRiverStage

SimAdvisory.title: SimAdvisory

note.default: Lines are written for the simulation; every number comes from the world model.
note.title: Note

SimRun.description:
A run's state. `report` is set only when `status` is `done`. `cancelled` (staff asked) and
`timeout` (the total time budget ran out) end a run without a report.
SimRun.title: SimRun

SiteBoundary.description:
The display-only Elmina outline with its geometry, for the stylised renderer's clip and
diorama slab. Routing, evaluation and answers never read it. `geometry` is null when the file
is missing, unreadable or not one Polygon / MultiPolygon.
SiteBoundary.title: SiteBoundary

StopPoint.description: The first known FAIL along the fastest route under the requested profile.
StopPoint.title: StopPoint

StreetFurnitureLayer.description:
Fact-bearing street furniture for the stylised 3D city (display only, B-T6/B-T7): one Point
per OSM traffic signal, bus stop, shelter, bench or picnic table inside the outline, plus seed
seating / shelter places that coincide with none of them (`source: seed_place`). Each feature
carries its source `id` and `kind`. Routing, evaluation and answers never read it.
StreetFurnitureLayer.title: StreetFurnitureLayer

TimedTag.description: A map tag shown for a window: the detour (hoarding impact) and the lorry route (R16).
TimedTag.title: TimedTag

UncheckedStretch.description: A contiguous run of recommended-route edges whose `attribute` is not checked yet.
UncheckedStretch.title: UncheckedStretch

VRRow.description: A VR plus the claim's current value, so staff see what Verify would confirm.
VRRow.title: VRRow

disclaimer.default: Survey plan from the township model: journeys would be confirmed only if they pass when staff check these facts on site. A planning estimate, not a promise.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

VerifyFact.description: Imagine staff verifying a fact: it passes every profile's limit, or it fails.
VerifyFact.title: VerifyFact

get.description:
The planner's belief over unchecked facts: Beta(alpha, beta) per path type and attribute,
from regional OSM tags (if built) and real staff verifications. Planning only.

Staff-reported closures. active=true (default): in force now; active=false: ended or not
started yet. Every row is a staff report, labelled as such. `note` is shown to staff only.

post.description: Public, hypothetical closure impact; no persistent writes or traffic counts.

schema.title: Response Day Scenarios Day Scenarios Get

get.description: One simulated day: 5,000 synthetic residents, counts by group, timeline and map tracks.

Imagined changes worth testing on this day, from its own trips (on a river-rise day the
flooded stretches the most residents rely on, then busy footways and steps).

post.description:
The same simulated day with and without imagined changes, trip by trip: who gains and
who loses, by group, and what the spotlight residents would say. Imagined, never a plan.

Rehearse my trip: a resident's own trip through the rehearsed day, at the asked time and
every 10 minutes around it (when it got through, when it was cut, and by which street).

The Development Simulation plan for the loaded world (the 45 s building timeline): site,
routed facts (detour, park and mall walks), cast, acts, bubbles, tags, banners, the hoarding
impact over every nearby home, the lorry route, the ESTIMATE schedule and cost with its
sources and month keys, flood exposure at handover, the daily-life access matrix, 40
simulated residents and the Impact Brief. Illustrative, not a forecast; 404 when the world
lacks the parcel (e.g. the tiny fixture).

404.description: development simulation not available for this world

post.description: Staff alias for atomic named closures, including each window and the actual reason.
Compatibility alias: accepts both the original event and general closure shapes.

schema.title: Response Simulate Event Events Simulate Post

post.description:
Staff-only JPEG/PNG upload (max 5 MB). Type is decided by magic bytes; metadata (EXIF,
GPS, comments, text chunks) is stripped before anything is stored.

get.description: Liveness that includes the world: a corrupt seed fails here, not only on every request.

post.description:
The journey for the recommended route between two places (spec 2026-10-19 §6.2).

Planned per request, like POST /routes (no route store, no verification requests filed).
The chat attaches the same plan to `journey.play` for the same endpoints, profile, scenario
and start time.

409.description: no route to play (route status and why)

422.description: unknown profile or bad start time

500.description: a journey event without route evidence (a data or rule bug)

get.description:
OSM buildings and trees. Declared before /layers/{lens} so it wins. 404 when the world has
no base/buildings.geojson (the client then falls back to the plain scene).

404.description: no buildings seed for this world

get.description:
Gap map: per walk edge and place, how many relevant facts are not yet checked, how many
are stale or only reported, open verification demand and simulated journey impact. Declared
before /layers/{lens} so it wins.
Named roads clipped to the township boundary; display only.

schema.title: Response Road Labels Layer Layers Road Labels Get

get.description:
Street furniture points (display only). Declared before /layers/{lens} so it wins. 404 when
the world has no base/street_furniture.geojson (the client then draws no fact props).

404.description: no street furniture seed for this world

502.description: the street furniture seed is unreadable

post.description: Public read-only proposal and hypothetical closure impact; no approval or writes.

get.description:
Synthetic residents per persona heading for the nearest evacuation centre at every river
stage, with routes for the 3D animation. Indicative simulation, not a forecast. Cached by
world version (the first call on the seed takes about 15 s).

503.description: the township model is busy; retry shortly

post.description: Plan only: this anonymous endpoint never files verification requests (the chat does).

Fastest route next to the profile's route (navigation compare, demo polish B3): stop
point, known-fact reasons, unchecked stretches, points of interest and `confirm_n`. Like
POST /routes it never files verification requests, so `vr` is always null.

schema.title: Response Scenario Water Scenarios  Scenario Id  Get

get.description: Documentation-only endpoint so OpenAPI exports the ChatEvent union.

post.description:
Start a run in the background and return its id; poll `GET /simulations/{run_id}`.

One run at a time per world: a second POST while one is queued or running gets 409 with the
running id, so the caller can poll that run instead.

409.description: a run is already in progress

post.description:
Stop a queued or running run. It ends as `cancelled` at once (the worker stops at its next
journey) and the run slot is free again. 404 unknown run, 409 if it already ended.

get.description: status=all returns every status. A resolved row's `resolution` omits the staff `note`.

post.description: Staff-filed VR; deduped against the open one (demand + 1). Same PDPA sanitising as chat.

get.description:
What this check would change (open) or changed (resolved) on the township model: sampled
journeys, the ticket's own journey and the belief. Staff planning estimate; counts only.

Who this ticket's path or place matters to in a rehearsed day: synthetic residents whose
trips cross it, by purpose and age group (a rehearsal, not a forecast; counts only).

schema.title: Response Ticket Reach Verification Requests  Vr Id  Reach Get

get.description:
Survey plan: which facts to check first so the most sample journeys would be confirmed.
The same cached tool the assistant calls (cached per world version and open tickets).

post.description: Imagine changes on a copy of the township and compare journeys before and after.

get.description: Engine-proposed what-if actions with readable labels (ramps, verifications, keystones).
